orderPathCardinality.model: y = b0 + item (i-1) + unit i(q-1) + coupon c + PRE + CC + s600 (base: INVOICE, no coupon, s60, i1q1)
orderPathCardinality.base: one item of one unit, INVOICE, no coupon, stock 60
orderPathCardinality.units: ms per order (createOrder + placeOrder + saga); CPU x r_c = production; statements per order

rateSensitivity.model: D(X) = a + b/X over the path containers

mechanisms.units: ms per request (CPU ms at full speed of one core for app/sidecar containers, DB container CPU ms for -db), production configuration unless named instrumented

copyRead.note: appDeltaMs = order's app CPU with copies minus without: the copy reads' mapping, the in-memory discount match and fee computation, minus the two saved outgoing invocations' client work

perEvent.note: app CPU per event at the copy writes' low rate (1-2 requests/s): an upper bound (sensitivity, RESULTS §sensitivity); DB per copy write from pg_stat_statements exec x k_db (the cgroup delta of order-db at these rates is noise of +-0.5 ms)

replicaReadDbMs.unit: DB ms per copy read statement

replicaReadCpuMs.unit: app CPU ms per createOrder answered from copies (net: copy reads, in-memory match and fees, minus the saved invocations' client work)

replicaWriteCpuMs.unit: app CPU ms per delivered copy event (whole handler, inbound HTTP included)

deliverCpuMs.unit: sidecar CPU ms per delivered event on the subscriber (dapr + ecs)

cacheHitCpuMs.unit: provider app CPU ms per hit (the hit is served behind the provider's sidecar: hop and gateway fetch remain)

cacheMissOverheadCpuMs.unit: provider app CPU ms per miss on top of the uncached call (store + GC)

cacheHitSavingMs.unit: provider app / DB ms saved per hit vs the uncached call

cacheHitRatio.note: a workload property (key reuse within the TTL), not measured: the hot sets are 4 keys by construction; keep the model's assumption

callerCacheHitCpuMs.unit: caller (order) app CPU ms per hit, net of the saved outbound call's client work (negative = the hit saves CPU in the caller too)

callerCacheSidecarSavingMs.unit: caller sidecars' CPU ms saved per hit (dapr + ecs)

callerCacheMissOverheadCpuMs.unit: caller app CPU ms per miss on top of the uncached call

callerCacheProviderSavingMs.unit: provider app / DB / sidecar CPU ms saved per hit

callerCacheHitRatio.note: a workload property (identical request bodies within the TTL), not measured

envelope.source: envelope.py on approx4_on_w1,approx4_on_w2,approx4_on_w3,approx4_rerun_on x this parts.json; deliveryCpuMs from mechanisms (block 6)
envelope.units: CPU ms per delivered event (handlers), per publish (senders), per request (requestOverheadCpuMs); hops: wall ms p50 (n-weighted over windows)
